prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
home, wait_info changes are helpful, producing 4 wins (+4.1%, +3.1%, +2.7%, +1.7%), while 2 tests showed no clear effect.
finish, new_flow changes can be helpful, yielding 3 wins (+11.3%, +7.2%, +3.7%), though 4 tests showed no clear effect.
adoption, redesign changes did not work, resulting in 1 guardrail rollback (-10.8%) and 1 test with no clear effect.
adoption, copy; sign_in, hint; and home, notification changes consistently showed no clear effect across all iterations.
sign_in, reorder and choose_path, redesign changes remain inconsistent, each generating 1 win and 1 significant loss.
Predictions consistently overestimate weak ideas and underestimate large wins, and evidence remains thin for kinds of change tested only once.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Mood and Interaction Onboarding Journey: Adds an interactive guided walkthrough on the final onboarding screen demonstrating how the pet reacts to mouse hovers, drags, and desktop idle states. (why: Support receives multiple tickets about confusion over controlling desktop pet interactions, and previous finish new_flow tests yielded high conversion wins (+11.3%, +7.2%).)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Placement Animated Preparation Ticker: Displays an animated live updates feed on the waiting screen showing exactly how the pet is being prepared for desktop rendering. (why: Wait_info changes on the home waiting step consistently produced conversion wins (+4.1%, +3.1%, +2.7%, +1.7%).)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Sequence Shift: Moves sign-in screen after adoption certificate creation to contextually link account registration with saving pet certificate details. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again, and moving sign-in after pet customization anchors value before account creation.)
3: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Two Column Stamp Review: Reorganizes the adoption certificate screen into a clear two-column layout highlighting pet details alongside final certificate confirmation. (why: Adoption stage experiences the biggest drop-off in the funnel (67.9% conversion); structural layout tweaks improve clarity without risky screen redesigns.)
4: [finish, new_flow] System Tray and Desktop Companion Dock Tutorial Flow: Adds an interactive step-by-step tutorial on home_intro showing how to dock, minimize, and restore the pet using system tray shortcuts. (why: Support received multiple tickets regarding pet visibility issues and desktop misbehavior; finish new_flow improvements have historically yielded huge wins (+11.3%, +7.2%).)
5: [sign_in, copy] Permanent Pet Account Recovery Assurance Copy: Updates headline and body copy on sign_in screen to explicitly state that sign-in protects against pet loss and allows instant restore across devices. (why: 8 support tickets (largest theme) cited missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
